text: (a) 4 points Let G be an undirected, unweighted graph with vertex set V and edge set E. Suppose that each edge e has additional attribute e.color, which is either red or green. A particular vertex is labelled N for the north pole, and a particular vertex is labelled S for the south pole. We would like a path from S to T that is either of all one color, OR starts in RED and switches to GREEN. Design an algorithm that solves this problem and justify the runtime of O(V + E). You do not need to write the pseudo-code, but you must carefully describe your steps. Remember to justify the runtime. S N
